response:
I am so sorry you experienced this. What you described is a severe breach of trust and confidentiality. Therapists are legally and ethically bound to keep your medical information private, and sharing your assessment results with your abuser is completely unacceptable. In the context of domestic abuse, this kind of disclosure can also put your safety at risk. You have every right to feel betrayed and unsafe with this practitioner. 

Please prioritize your physical and emotional safety right now. I strongly encourage you to seek support from a new, individual therapist who specializes in domestic abuse, and you may want to consider reporting this therapist to their state licensing board for violating your privacy. If you feel unsafe at home or need immediate guidance, please reach out to the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-SAFE or text "START" to 88788. You deserve a secure, strictly confidential space to heal.
